_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED BY THE 9/2 PRE-CLOSE. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, AND THAT IS A CHECKED RESULT RATHER THAN A SKIPPED STEP: this file holds exactly one row, AVGO, and its event lands AFTER TONIGHT'S CLOSE - hours ahead of this run rather than behind it - so no row carries a date in the past and nothing is stale. The 9/3 open owns removing this row once the print has happened. THE EVENT WAS RE-VERIFIED ON A LIVE FORWARD EARNINGS PULL covering 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-09 rather than inherited from the note the 9/1 pre-close left: AVGO fiscal Q3 2026, report date 2026-09-02, timing pm, verified true, estimate 3.16, no actual yet. SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE, unconditionally rather than because it looked stale: AVGO 368.00 bid / 368.05 ask at 2026-09-02T19:35:41.216415742Z, last 368.025, against a 369.68 settled close, so -0.45% on the session. That replaces the 369.75 the 9/1 pre-close wrote. It is a far smaller correction than yesterday's 6.71-point one and it is made with exactly the same indifference to its size: a refresh performed only when the number already looks wrong is the AMD-at-522.95-on-a-486-morning failure waiting to happen again, and the discipline is the unconditional pull rather than the judgement about when to make it. THE BOARD IS FLAT INTO THE PRINT AND THEREFORE NOTHING CROSSES IT, established on live pulls at 15:35 rather than inherited: equity positions empty, option positions with nonzero=true empty, both order lists empty on a 2026-08-26 floor, 1011.15 all settled with unsettled 0.0000. The day's only specification, the 09:45 MDT buy at a 93.07 limit, was checked against branch one at the open and did not bind - a medical-device maker carries no read-through from a semiconductor print - and it expired unexecuted at 15:30 with the tape 0.36 BELOW its own limit, so the question is moot twice over. impliedMove STAYS NULL BECAUSE NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED, and that is correct rather than an omission: item 3 is owed before an earnings HOLD, no position exists to hold, and a number this board did not pull does not exist. Both branches are untouched and keep their why. THE WIDER CLUSTER IS RE-CONFIRMED ON THE SAME PULL AND IS DELIBERATELY NOT ADDED AS ROWS: AI, SNOW, NTAP, FIVE, PVH, HPE, GOLD and AGX report tonight alongside AVGO, then LULU, ZS, DOCU, GWRE, CIEN, IOT, PATH, AMBA and ASAN on 9/3, and GME, CASY, BRZE and TTAN on 9/8. A row enters this file when a branch can be decided in advance for it, not because a date exists; adding nine names with no position and no candidacy would be noise wearing the shape of diligence, and the AVGO branch already binds any semiconductor or enterprise-software entry whose five-session time stop would carry it through this window.

It becomes owed the moment a position exists that would carry through the print - which, with the print landing tonight, is now nobody's, and the row's remaining job is to bind the 9/3 open against buying the reaction bar.

branches.cond: An entry considered in AVGO itself, or in a semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy name, whose five-session time stop would carry it through 2026-09-02
branches.act: Refused unless the position is sized and stopped to survive the gap, or is closed before the print by a pre-close run that says so explicitly
branches.why: This is the same arithmetic that refused AVGO this morning and SMCI on 8/12, applied forward to the date rather than rediscovered on 9/1. A -8% equity stop does not survive an event gap: the realistic bad case gaps THROUGH the exit rather than filling at it, so the stop is decorative and the real risk is the implied move, unpriced. The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright. What makes this a branch rather than a blanket ban is the escape clause named in it - a position may still be opened if it is deliberately closed before the print, and the run that opens it must write that intention down at entry rather than discover the conflict on 9/1.

branches.cond: An entry is opened on or after 2026-08-28 whose time stop lands on or after 9/2, and the run wants to hold it through the print
branches.act: The ATM straddle is pulled and quoted first, or there is no hold
branches.why: Item 3 of the checklist, stated as a dated duty so that no run has to infer it. This board has a standing rule that a number which was not pulled does not exist, and item 3 is the place that rule is most often quietly skipped - because the straddle is only owed before a HOLD, it is tempting to treat the hold as already decided and the number as a formality. It is the other way round: the number decides the hold. SMCI was refused on exactly this reading when a 14.2% implied move was found to swallow an 8% stop.

branches.cond: AVGO gaps hard on 9/2 and the 9/3 open wants to trade the reaction
branches.act: Not on the reaction bar - the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is the entry, and item 2 governs
branches.why: Written now, six sessions early and with nothing at stake, for the same reason branch one of the MRVL row was widened on 8/21 before it cost anything: a pre-commitment made on the morning it binds is not a pre-commitment. The reaction day is not the entry this rulebook buys, and a +8% gap is a wait signal rather than a buy signal. NVDA on 8/27 is the worked example this board already has - it was refused at +7.33% on the reaction bar, a tenth of a point off the line, with the gap landing into the top of its own prior congestion.
